# Design: Kiro-native spirits

## Overview

```
 human ──"add dark mode"──▶ the Crypt (selecle-crypt agent, no tools)
                               │ plan: { spec: {name, request} }
                               ▼
                         Scribe spirit (selecle-scribe, writes only .kiro/specs/**)
                               │ requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md → merged
                               ▼
 human ──"build it"──────▶ the Crypt: { build: name }
                               ▼
                 spec run: task 1 ─▶ merged ─▶ task 2 ─▶ merged ─▶ …
                 (builder / tester / chronicler agents, each in its own grave)
                               │
            every spirit ──MCP──▶ selecle mcp (the séance): room · deeds · spec · whisper
            every spirit ──resources──▶ .kiro/steering/**/*.md
```

## Facts checked against Kiro CLI 3.2.1 (2026-11-12)

- Global agents in `~/.kiro/agents/*.json` load with `chat --agent <name>` from any folder, and their
  relative `file://` resources resolve in the folder the run starts in (the spirit's worktree).
- A headless run (`--no-interactive`) uses engine v2: `tools`, `allowedTools`, `toolsSettings`.
  A write outside `toolsSettings.write.allowedPaths` is refused ("tool permission approval is not
  supported in non-interactive mode").
- Kiro upgrades a v2-only config in place (adds `permissions` and `kiroUpgrade`, leaves a `.bak`);
  a config that already has `permissions` is left alone.
- An agent's MCP server starts with the run's working folder and inherits its environment.
  `tool_call` events for MCP tools carry `_meta.kiro.mcpServerName` and `toolName`.
- Kiro's own spec mode (`--v3 --mode spec`) refuses file tools headless unless given
  `--trust-all-tools` (shell included), so selecle writes specs with its own Scribe agent instead.

## Components and Interfaces

### `src/kiro/agents.js`
- `ROLES` (builder, tester, chronicler, scribe): title, blurb, role prompt, write globs.
- `agentConfigs({ mcp })` returns `[{ name, json }]`; the description ends with `[selecle <sha12>]`.
- `installAgents({ dir, configs })` writes only changed configs. `ensureAgents()` once per process;
  false when `SELECLE_KIRO_AGENTS=0`, under `node --test` without `SELECLE_KIRO_AGENTS_DIR`, or on error.

### `src/kiro/specs.js`
- `parseTasks(text)`: unindented `- [ ] N. title` lines; `[x]` done; `[ ]*` optional; indented lines
  are details; `_Spirit: role_` picks the role.
- `readSpec`, `listSpecs`, `specLine`, `countRequirements`, `specSlug`, `scribeTask`, `buildTask`.

### `src/kiro/specrun.js`
- `createSpecRunner({ root, summon, say })` → `write`, `build`, `spiritDone`, `cancel`, `status`.
- A task "landed" when its spirit rests with a merge commit (or there are no graves).

### `src/kiro/steering.js`
- `readSteering`, `inclusionOf`, `bodyOf`, `steeringText` (skips manual, 8,000 chars),
  `steeringGaps(root, cwd)` / `steeringNote` for uncommitted steering.

### `src/seance.js`
- `SEANCE_TOOLS`, `callTool`, `handleMessage` (initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call),
  `runSeance` (stdio), `projectRoot` (`SELECLE_PROJECT`, else `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`).
- `whisper` appends a `friend` event `{ from: 'spirit', spirit }` to `.selecle/crypt.jsonl`.

### Changes to existing modules
- `engines.js`: `kiroArgs({ agent })`; `kiroEngine` picks `selecle-<role>`, sets `SELECLE_PROJECT` and
  `SELECLE_SPIRIT`; MCP tool calls become actions; `cliEngine({ env })`; the mock acts out specs.
- `roster.js`: `summon(task, { role, spec })`; the launch passes role, spec, root, spirit and
  uncommitted steering.
- `crypt.js`: plan `{ reply, summon: [{task, role}], banish, spec, build }` (`normalise` exported);
  prompt gains specs and steering; the Kiro Crypt runs as `selecle-crypt`; the mock understands
  `feature:`, `build`, `test:`, `docs:`.
- `app.js`: `state.specs`, `/spec`, `/kiro`, roles in notices, the ledger and snapshots; spirit
  whispers in the coven chat.
- `remote.js`: a guest's spirit run carries role and spec.
- `bin/selecle.js`: `selecle mcp` (before anything prints), `selecle kiro`.

## Data Models

- Plan: `{ reply, summon: [{ task, role }], banish: [name], spec: { name, request } | null, build: name | null }`.
- Spirit: `+ role`, `+ spec: { kind: 'write', name, request } | { kind: 'task', name, number }`.
- Deed and spirit snapshot: `+ role`.
- Whisper event: `{ type: 'friend', from: 'spirit', spirit: { name, kind, face, rgb, role }, text }`.

## Error Handling

| Case | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Agents folder not writable | spirits run as plain Kiro with `--trust-tools` |
| Scribe fails or no tasks.md | "the spec … is not ready" |
| Task falls / merges nothing / clashes | the run pauses; `/spec build` resumes |
| Spirit banished mid-run | the run stops, with a note |
| Spec built or written twice at once | refused with the reason |
| Third whisper, or no room open | MCP error result with a reason |
| Bad JSON on the séance | JSON-RPC -32700; unknown method -32601 |

## Testing Strategy

- `test/kiro.test.js` (26 tests): agent configs and install, kiroArgs, MCP verbs, steering, tasks
  parsing, the spec runner (write, approve, order, roles, pause, resume, cancel), the plan, the
  Crypt's prompt, the mock Crypt, the whole flow in the app on a real git project with the mock
  engine, `/kiro`, `/spec`, and the séance (protocol, tools, room discovery, stdio, a real
  `selecle mcp` process).
- A real run against Kiro CLI 3.2.1 (see tasks.md task 8).
